EVE IN THE GARDEN OF EDEN. A young woman with a calm, wondering face, warm light-olive skin, and very long dark-brown wavy hair falling past her waist, with small green leaves and a vine woven into it as a crown. She wears a dress made of woven green leaves and vines — leaf shoulders, a leaf-lined bodice, and a long skirt of layered leaves and soft green cloth falling to her ANKLES, so her bare feet show beneath it. Bare arms, bare feet.

HER RIGHT ARM IS RAISED, HOLDING UP A SINGLE RED-GOLD APPLE at head height, looking at it. Her left hand rests open at her side. Calm, curious, NOT afraid, NOT sorrowful. No serpent, no tree, no other figure.

Warm hand-illustrated storybook style with clean flat shapes and soft painted shading, matching the reference figures exactly in proportion, line weight and palette warmth. Head to feet, full length, both bare feet at the bottom edge, on FLAT MAGENTA #FF00FF.
